revisions.prompt: Create ONE professional hand-drawn 2D cel-animation TOWER DEFENSE gameplay screen, landscape 16:10. A bright adventurous sky-island cartoon game with bold thick dark contours, broad solid saturated cobalt blue, tomato red, sun yellow, grass green, and white cloud shapes. ONLY TWO OR THREE COLOR TONES per material. Flat animation cels, confident expressive poses, almost no surface texture, no tiny bricks or photoreal details. Elevated orthographic playfield is big and readable, 7 fixed-position towers and 12 walking enemy units along an S-shaped path on a floating island. Assets have exaggerated strong silhouettes: tall timber ballista with red pennant, squat enormous brass cannon on short base, three-prong weather-ice machine with blue rotating vanes. Enemies are small armored pirate birds, brass wheeled automata and a broad mechanical turtle boss with red shell. Defending fortress is clean bold navy/red geometry, a large gate, huge white clouds outside the playfield. Brief stylized impact stars and flying projectile trails, never all-screen explosions. Whole image must look like an actual high-quality 2D animated video game, not painterly fantasy concept art and not 3D rendering. Bottom20% is compact game HUD in flat navy with simple bright yellow selection outlines, three large tower portraits on left, Korean question and 4 answers on right. Top compact WAVE 06, 15/15, gold142, pause. Exact Korean question “‘신중하다’의 뜻은?” and four answers “조심스럽게 생각하고 행동하다”, “몹시 서두르다”, “힘이 매우 세다”, “소리가 매우 크다”. No extra text. Clear generous Korean type. NO ornate gold frame, NO parchment, NO gradient buttons, NO pastel colors, NO corporate icons or kindergarten sticker art.
